rationale: C10 is an essentially verbatim annual predecessor and the immediately preceding displayed instance. The child preserves its operative extension mechanism, twenty-five-year term, covered Indian land patents, exception for congressional reservations, and nearly all wording, changing principally the expiration year from 1950 to 1951. C05 and C09 are earlier versions of the same recurring template but are less proximate and contain an additional effective-date clause absent from both C10 and the child.
